thread:
Priya: quick sync: proposing a tiny opt-in header `x-rw-route-policy` so Console can steer staged rollout traffic into dedicated pools. goal: hint-only, no tenant changes. need SDK flags + telemetry mapping.
Chris: additive-only makes sense. how does this interact with routehint/affinity today?
Anya: it9s a hint that coexists with affinity. server ignores unknown values. SDKs would expose an opt-in param `routing_policy` on constructors and per-request. default: no header.
Sam: two ops points: 1) quota attribution (we currently map cost center from tenant) and 2) telemetry visibility for rollout dashboards. we should pick a canonical namespace.
Priya: suggested format: `console/<workspace>/<policy>` e.g. `console/acme/gradual-1`. console will keep a whitelist. SDKs pass string but require experimental opt-in.
Luca: telemetry plan: emit `route.policy` span tag + add `route_policy` label on cost metrics. must avoid cardinality explosion. server should normalize unknowns to `console/_unknown`.
Chris: agreed on normalization. SDKs should not accept arbitrary freeform strings unless explicitly enabled.
Anya: SDK UX: constructor-level opt-in + per-request override. python example:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='...', routing_policy='console/acme/gradual-1')
resp = c.generate('hi', routing_policy=None)  # override per call
```
TS example:
```ts
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey, routingPolicy: 'console/acme/gradual-1' });
await client.generate({ prompt: 'hey' });
```
Sam: rollout steps: 1) server header acceptance + whitelist normalize 2) telemetry + metric label plumbing with collapsed default 3) add SDK opt-in param in Py/TS/Go (experimental) 4) console behind feature flag to start internal canaries 5) monitor quota attribution + cost dashboards 48h then expand.
DevInfraBot: deployment reminder - add sample policies to canary config and update ingestion mapping.
Priya: timeline ask: can we demo in sandpit next week? Chris/Anya/Sam please own SDK PRs + server flag.
Chris: I9ll do python + go stubs + tests (2 days each).
Anya: I9ll do TS + docs.
Sam: I9ll add server acceptance + telemetry label + cardinality guard.
Priya: deliverables: docs with opt-in warning, unit test samples asserting header, server tests for normalization fallback, console ticket will be linked here. :rocket:
